authority: User requirements in this conversation; durable capability and measurement requirements
execution_effect: Requirements only; does not change a running policy, evaluator, training budget, controller, or deployment
change_policy: Preserve this version and historical results. User changes require an explicit successor version; a failure does not authorize lowering requirements.

training_origin.nominal_mechanical_initialization_prior: Allowed when documented; no learned weights or runtime scripted recovery

standing_contact.ignore_rule: Ignore each maximal consecutive raw unsupported interval whose observed duration is<=2ms for acceptance; preserve raw samples, raw count/duration and ignored intervals in diagnostics.
standing_contact.evaluation_start: Actual logged self-righting/recovery-completed event, followed by the declared stationary command; no fallen/passive/get-up samples in the standing-contact denominator. Direct initialized-standing tests use their explicit standing-start event.
standing_contact.relapse_rule: A later fall remains a recovery/standing failure and must not be erased by moving the start forward again.
standing_contact.current_raw_observer: Both wheel contact force norms strictly exceed2N. This is a load/contact classification, not proof of geometric lift-off. Preserve force and estimated wheel-bottom clearance.
standing_contact.longer_loss_rule: Intervals longer than2ms remain counted; no force-threshold change or removal of original evidence.

stationary_spin.measured_quantity: Actual body yaw rate, not wheel speed, requested command, clipped command, or reward

capabilities.requirement: Recover from initial front/back/left/right/upside-down and asymmetric leg poses; stabilize and continue the requested task
Detect and recover quickly after a real fall during forward/reverse/turning/spinning motion; resume the request without scripted assistance
Stable quiet low/mid/high standing after actual recovery completion, with continuous effective dual-wheel support allowing<=2ms pulses, small true XY drift and no sustained outward drift
Track low positive and negative speeds and the straight path smoothly
Track high forward and reverse speeds while retaining straight-path accuracy and balance
Target100rpm, at least80rpm, both directions, near the same ground location without falling or vibration
Forward-left, forward-right, reverse-left and reverse-right simultaneous translation and turning, including transitions
Smooth standing height changes without meaningful wheel lift, excessive drift or loss of balance; apply the post-completion<=2ms contact tolerance
Change height during forward/reverse/turning motion while maintaining tracking and balance
Change height during both spin directions while maintaining yaw, location and balance
Abruptly command zero from high forward and reverse speeds; stop promptly, smoothly and upright with small overshoot and little rebound
All tasks must avoid high-frequency leg/wheel excitation, contact chatter and dangerous measured joint speed
Confirm nominal and randomized held-out dynamics, actuator/sensor/timing/friction domains, seeds and disturbances; preserve all failures

leg_wheel_coordination.use_case: Coordinate hip/knee motion to move wheel centers fore/aft relative to the body together with driven-wheel control for acceleration, reversal and braking
measure: wheel-center fore/aft body position and velocity

inherited_references.high_stance_recentering: Keep the prior30s final10s mean radius<=max(5cm,80percent peak) and outward radial slope<=1mm/s; finite-window evidence only
inherited_references.note: Apply the corrected post-recovery measurement scope and<=2ms interval tolerance. Historical strict raw results remain preserved; survival-only success is still insufficient.

not_yet_quantified_by_user: maximum time from fall to stable recovery
allowed transient speed/yaw errors and settling time for every requested speed
maximum straight-path lateral and heading error
maximum spin-center excursion and long-term drift
maximum height-transition settling time and overshoot
maximum braking time, distance, overshoot and rebound
absolute smoothness limits for spectral energy, jerk, torque slew and joint speed across dynamic recovery
unquantified_rule: Retain these objectives and report their measurements. Freeze engineering test ranges and numeric thresholds before each new evaluation; do not represent an unspecified value as a user-approved threshold or infer overall qualification from an absent limit.

evidence.curve_source: Existing RSL-RL TensorBoard event logging; checkpoint, native trace, contract, judgment and SHA receipts preserve provenance

change_reason: Direct user correction2026-10-26: count contact only after actual recovery completion; ignore individual contact-loss runs<=2ms for acceptance; the reported0.0036deg leg-angle RMS is negligible; prioritize noise/domain robustness, and<=1cm standing drift is very good.

smoothness_interpretation.rule: The cited approximately0.0036deg band-limited leg-angle RMS and its tiny difference are negligible and do not independently fail acceptance or justify further optimization solely to reduce them.
smoothness_interpretation.scope: This does not identify the source as IMU/motor noise or prove all-frequency wheel/torque/dynamic behavior is smooth.

standing_drift_preference.rule: Approximately1cm or less is very good; do not treat it as an additional hard rejection threshold. Preserve raw excursion, terminal offset and outward trend, with the prior5/5/10cm references until changed.

optimization_priority: Improve retained standing under motor/encoder/IMU noise and progressively randomized domains rather than minimizing negligible nominal leg-angle RMS or<=2ms contact pulses. Preserve all other task coverage and fresh-training rules.
